_readme: Duty 7 blind re-classification of duty7-sample.json, as of 2026-10-07. Own knowledge and fresh web lookups only; no base, classification or research file was opened.

mona-ai.basis: EUR 2M round of Nov 2024 from Earlybird-X and others; the June 2026 EUR 3.8M round with Earlybird-X is called a Seed-Extension, so the 2024 round is the Seed (the 2024 coverage I could read does not name it). https://www.deutsche-startups.de/2026/06/22/flagright-erhaelt-125-millionen/ ; Earlybird page: HQ Saarbruecken, invested 2024.

madvertise.basis: Series A closed with Earlybird and Team Europe Ventures on 2010-03-30 (https://techcrunch.com/2010/03/30/mobile-ad-network-madvertise-secures-series-a-round/); Mobile Network Group announced the takeover of madvertise Media on 2014-01-09 (https://www.deutsche-startups.de/2014/01/09/mobile-network-group-uebernimmt-madvertise/). Caveat: the technology arm was split off as LiquidM in 2013 with Earlybird as a backer; I found no outcome for LiquidM.

gmd.acquirer: Dianoema S.p.A. (renamed NoemaLife 2006, part of Dedalus since 2016)
gmd.basis: Register history: GMD (Munich HRB 127041) moved its seat to Berlin in 2004 and was renamed NoemaLife GmbH in July 2008, today Dedalus Labor GmbH, Bonn (https://www.northdata.de/Dedalus+Labor+GmbH,+Bonn/HRB+26437); Milano Finanza 2006-02-13 says Noemalife entered Germany 'in past years' by buying GMD. The year 2003 is an estimate (range 2002 to 2004), no source gives it. HQ was Munich until 2004 (LION bioscience 20-F), Berlin after. No source names Earlybird's round or year (late 1990s).

yoom.acquirer: Malte Niebuhr (founder, bought the platform out of the insolvency estate)
yoom.basis: Insolvency Sept 2011 (https://www.deutsche-startups.de/2011/09/05/yoom-insolvenz/), then the founder bought Yoom with all brand rights and user data from the insolvency estate, reported 2012-05-30 (https://www.deutsche-startups.de/2012/05/30/kurzmitteilungen-delivery-hero-pizzaonline-fi-yoom-elitepartner-de-sunbonoo/); counted as acquired under the asset-sale rule, defunct if a founder buy-back does not count. Earlybird first invested in 2009 (deutsche-startups 2010-01-11: 'investierte bereits im vergangenen Jahr'); the April 2010 money is called 'weiteres Wachstumskapital'; no source names the 2009 round.

payable.basis: Payable Limited (company 13892749, director Daniel Yubi) resolved to wind up on 2024-12-12, members' voluntary liquidation with a declaration of solvency, no sale found (https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/13892749/filing-history); payable.co now redirects to the founder's blog. $6.1M seed led by CRV and Earlybird, Oct 2022 (https://www.finextra.com/newsarticle/41122/payable-raises-61m-to-modernise-business-payments).

terralayr-ag.basis: Earlybird page: HQ Zug, invested 2023. The equity raised up to Oct 2024 (EUR 62M, with Creandum, Earlybird, Norrsken, Picus, Rive) is called a seed round by TechCrunch (https://techcrunch.com/2024/10/17/former-watch-trader-is-now-building-the-aws-of-grid-storage-terralayr/); the 2023 first tranche (about EUR 20M, Creandum-led) is not named on its own. EUR 192M round led by Eurazeo in Jan 2026, no valuation published.

alantos-pharmaceuticals.basis: Earlybird came in as co-lead of the EUR 24.1M second round (Series B) of July 2003, when Therascope became Alantos; returning investors were only Auriga and Heidelberg Innovation (https://www.bionity.com/en/news/25948/). Amgen bought Alantos for $300M in cash in June 2007; the company had moved from Heidelberg to Cambridge, Massachusetts in 2004 (https://www.fiercebiotech.com/biotech/press-release-amgen-to-acquire-alantos-pharmaceuticals).

oviva.basis: Earlybird named as the new investor in the $21M Series B led by MTIP, announced 2020-01-14 (https://techcrunch.com/2020/01/14/oviva/); Earlybird Health page says invested 2019. $220M Series D led by Kinnevik in Jan 2026 with no valuation published, so no $1B figure to cite. Oviva AG is registered at Zuercherstrasse 64, 8852 Altendorf (https://oviva.com/ch/de/impressum/); Earlybird's page still says Zurich.

everoad-by-sennder.basis: Convargo (later Everoad) raised a $19M Series A led by Inventure Partners and Earlybird in Oct 2017 (https://techcrunch.com/2017/10/25/convargo-grabs-19-million-to-improve-road-freight/); sennder took it over in a share deal announced 2020-06-09 (https://www.reuters.com/article/markets/europe/german-freight-tech-start-up-sennder-merges-with-frances-everoad-idUSL4N2DL2JB/).

curio.basis: Curio Labs Limited (company 10145832) went into creditors' voluntary liquidation in May/June 2025, final meeting return filed Aug 2026 (https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/10145832/filing-history); curio.io carries the founders' closure notice, no sale found. Earlybird led the $9M Series A of Sept 2020 (https://techcrunch.com/2020/09/10/curio/).
